{{Quote|The dark side has failed you, Shakren san Jukii.|The Jedi Knight|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Jedi Knight''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Galactic War]], and had some history with the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Razer|Shakren san Jukii]] before san Jukii became the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Razer. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] spearheaded an aerial assault on the [[Imperial Garrison (Corellia)|Imperial Garrison]] in [[Axial Park]], and made straight for Razer, engaging him in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] struck down Razer, but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the moments following by the Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officers]] present in the room.
